description: This file defines the FileCookieJar class responsible for persisting cookies into a JSON file and loading them back, specifically for non-session cookies. It extends the CookieJar class and interacts with cookies via JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: FileCookieJar
classes.description: A class that persists cookies to a JSON file, allowing cookies to be saved and loaded across sessions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FileCookieJar with a filename and an option to store session cookies. Loads existing cookies if the file exists.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Saves cookies to the file upon object destruction.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes cookies into JSON and writes them to the specified file.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads cookies from a JSON-formatted file, adding them to the cookie jar.
